a: The cell membrane controls what enters and leaves the cell.
The nucleus holds most of a eukaryotic cell's DNA.
Mitochondria produce ATP through cellular respiration.
Chloroplasts perform photosynthesis in plant cells.
Osmosis is water diffusion across a semipermeable membrane.
Diffusion is net movement from high to low concentration.
Active transport moves substances against gradients using energy.
Producers make organic compounds, often via photosynthesis.
Consumers obtain energy by eating other organisms.
